work.title: Surprise with Targets 2
work.description: Large-format collage on crumpled paper features a black chess-piece king in the upper left, scattered red rectangles, graffiti-style lettering, and two bold bullseye targets along the lower edge. Handwritten text reading 'SURPRISE' anchors the lower right quadrant alongside layered paper fragments and gestural ink marks.
work.composition: Sparse field with lower-edge target band
